imul.description: Signed multiply: imul destination, source. Result in destination register.

idiv.description: Signed divide: idiv divisor. RDX:RAX / divisor -> quotient in RAX, remainder in RDX.
idiv.example: cqo; idiv %rdi  ; RDX:RAX / RDI -> RAX=quotient, RDX=remainder

setcc.description: Set byte on condition. Sets AL to 1 if condition true, 0 if false.

variants.setle: setle %al  ; Set if less or equal (signed, SF!=OF or ZF=1)
variants.setg: setg %al  ; Set if greater (signed, SF=OF and ZF=0)
variants.setge: setge %al  ; Set if greater or equal (signed, SF=OF)
variants.setbe: setbe %al  ; Set if below or equal (unsigned, CF=1 or ZF=1)
variants.seta: seta %al  ; Set if above (unsigned, CF=0 and ZF=0)
variants.setae: setae %al  ; Set if above or equal (unsigned, CF=0)

jmp_labels.description: Unconditional jump to label. Labels are .L.name format.

conditional_jumps.jle: jle .L.label  ; Jump if less or equal (signed)
conditional_jumps.jge: jge .L.label  ; Jump if greater or equal (signed)
conditional_jumps.jbe: jbe .L.label  ; Jump if below or equal (unsigned)
conditional_jumps.jae: jae .L.label  ; Jump if above or equal (unsigned)

chibicc_key_insights.if_else_pattern: gen_expr(cond); cmp_zero; je .L.else.N; gen_expr(then); jmp .L.end.N; .L.else.N: gen_expr(els); .L.end.N:
chibicc_key_insights.critical_note: SETcc only sets the low byte (AL). Must use MOVZX or MOVZB to zero-extend to full register before using as 64-bit value.
